connector.name: Maindex Smart Memory Service
connector.registryDescription: Simple memory for AI: keep, recall, update, and forget information across sessions.
connector.summary: Hosted at maindex.io over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.maindex, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Maindex API key. Create one at https://maindex.io/dashboard/settings
